name: moh731V2023Moh729bTptBase
description: MOH 729B F-MAPS, TPT HIV Positive: the clients MOH 731 3.4 Starting TPT counts (HV03-031 Start TPT_<15 and HV03-032 Start TPT_15+, moh731V2023StartingTptBase -- the same sources, filters and grouping, so the same clients: active, started ART and TPT this month, screened for TB at this month's visit), with the TPT regimen started: TUBERCULOSIS PROPHYLAXIS STARTED (1264, else the patient-reported 1110) from the TPT start date to the end of the month -- ISONIAZID (656) is 6H, ISONIAZID AND RIFAPENTINE (11883) is 3HP. Codes: 15 years and over ATPT1A 6H / ATPT1B 3HP, under 15 CTPT1A 6H / CTPT1B 3HP; a client with no TPT drug recorded gets no code (regimen 'Not recorded') and so is in no cell of the form.

join.joinCondition: pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = hmrd.person_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = hmrd.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 8 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

columns.comment: The screening result is a concept; its name, e.g. NONE (no symptoms)

expressionOptions.expression: COALESCE((SELECT cn.name FROM amrs.concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = hmrd.tb_screening_result AND cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND cn.voided = 0 ORDER BY cn.concept_name_id LIMIT 1), hmrd.tb_screening_result)

CASE (SELECT o.value_coded FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.person_id = hmrd.person_id AND o.concept_id IN (1264, 1110) AND o.value_coded IN (656, 11883) AND o.voided = 0 AND o.obs_datetime < DATE_ADD(hmrd.endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.obs_datetime >= DATE(hmrd.ipt_start_date) ORDER BY (o.concept_id = 1264) DESC, o.obs_datetime ASC, o.obs_id ASC LIMIT 1) WHEN 656 THEN '6H' WHEN 11883 THEN '3HP' ELSE 'Not recorded' END

CASE (SELECT o.value_coded FROM amrs.obs o WHERE o.person_id = hmrd.person_id AND o.concept_id IN (1264, 1110) AND o.value_coded IN (656, 11883) AND o.voided = 0 AND o.obs_datetime < DATE_ADD(hmrd.endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND o.obs_datetime >= DATE(hmrd.ipt_start_date) ORDER BY (o.concept_id = 1264) DESC, o.obs_datetime ASC, o.obs_id ASC LIMIT 1) WHEN 656 THEN IF(hmrd.age < 15, 'CTPT1A', 'ATPT1A') WHEN 11883 THEN IF(hmrd.age < 15, 'CTPT1B', 'ATPT1B') END
